content_sections.heading: About IIEST Shibpur
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Engineering Science & Technology (IIEST), Shibpur is located in Howrah, West Bengal. This notice comes from its Office of the Dean Research and Consultancy, for a post in the Department of Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering (ETCE).

content_sections.heading: IIEST Shibpur Senior Research Fellow Vacancy Details 2026
IIEST Shibpur Senior Research Fellow Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Maximum 32 years. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for SC, ST, OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates. Candidates need one of the following degrees from a recognised university or institute: M.E./M.Tech. in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Materials Science, Bioengineering or Nanotechnology M.E./M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering with specializations related to sensor devices, electrochemistry or equivalent M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics Engineering with Microelectronics specialization or any allied fields M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Biochemistry or Life Sciences The degree must be passed with at least 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale; SC/ST/PwD candidates need at least 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA. A valid GATE/NET score is required in all cases. Two years of research experience is mandatory. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the walk-in interview. Shortlisting may be done before the interview based on the documents emailed. Original documents are checked at the time of joining, and the selection will be cancelled if any discrepancy is found during this physical verification.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The project runs for four years from the date of commencement or till the project continues, whichever is earlier. The SRF will work in the Department of Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering, IIEST Shibpur, Howrah.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIEST Shibpur Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Write an application letter on plain paper and prepare a recent bio-data. Self-attest the application letter, bio-data, mark sheets and certificates. Mention a valid email id and phone number in the application. Email the soft copies to Prof. Chirasree Roy Chaudhuri (PI), Department of Electronic and Telecommunication Engineering, at [email protected] by 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026. Attend the interview at 1:00 PM on 1 December 2026 at the Office of the Dean (R&C), IIEST, Shibpur. Documents to email: application letter, recent bio-data, mark sheets and certificates, all self-attested.

faq.question: Q1. When is the IIEST Shibpur SRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 1 December 2026 at 1:00 PM at the Office of the Dean (R&C), IIEST, Shibpur.

faq.question: Q2. Do I need to send anything before the interview?
faq.answer: Yes. Soft copies of your application letter, bio-data, mark sheets and certificates must reach [email protected] by 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How much does the Senior Research Fellow earn?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 42,000 plus Rs. 12,600 HRA at 30%, a total of Rs. 54,600 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is GATE or NET compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes, a valid GATE/NET is required along with the master's degree and two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q5. What marks do SC/ST/PwD candidates need?
faq.answer: At least 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale, against 60% or 6.5 CGPA for others.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Maximum 32 years, relaxable up to 5 years for SC, ST, OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: The project runs four years from commencement or till the project continues, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Who is funding this project?
faq.answer: The project is sponsored by ANRF, Govt. of India, under the PAIR Network.
